chunk_rule: L11 (1): a chunk = 32 consecutive list positions (REC generation.batch_size; the job refuses another value); each chunk is its own greedy_generate call; never one whole-list call (the engine sorts a call's prompts by length)
cuda: untested on CUDA; checked on CPU fixtures only

s3.keep: every answer is kept; capped ones are flagged; a y^orig that encode_train refuses leaves the SAS ranking and is counted (L14 (1)); REQ-3's pool s3_orig holds the others with ids <id>:orig
s3.source: REQ-6's s3_safe.pool.json: the S3 subset (1,000) and S1's rows outside it (L10 (2))

s4.keep_rule: L14 (2): kept only if it ended, its lexicon class is REFUSAL-OPENING, answer.strip() is non-empty and encode_train(prompt, answer, S.max_train_tokens) accepts; the first failing check is the drop reason (capped, empty, not_refusal_opening, encode_train_<error>); the first 48 kept in list order form S4; stop after the chunk that holds the 48th, later keeps in it counted as kept_after_the_48th; fewer than 48 after 512 prompts: counts only and exit 3 (L11 (2))

sd600.keep: every answer is kept; the capped count, and per row ended, empty and encode_train's verdict, are recorded (L14 (3): REQ-15 decides rewrite or remove)

loss.definition: W1-06: the engine's example_losses (per-example mean NLL over the response and end-of-turn targets, the training loss) of the untuned model on encode_train(prompt, response, S.max_train_tokens), and its exp; per row id; encode_train refusals counted; rows: S1's 48 (prompt, PKU-safe response), the s3_safe pool (prompt, PKU-safe response), and S4's 48 kept rows (prompt, untuned answer) when S4 ran

max_new_tokens_rule: S3: 512 (SPEC section 3.5 item 2); S4 and SD-600: REC's generation.max_new_tokens (2,048; L14)
name: make_untuned_answers
outputs: into --out: answers_<list>.json, s4.json, s3_orig.pool.json (text; the kit pulls them to tmp/) and untuned_answers_record.json (text-free)

pins.rule: REC gives the model, the generation settings and max_prompt_tokens; recipe S gives max_train_tokens (L14: read, never hard-coded); the job refuses unless REC and S agree on model.max_train_tokens, model.max_prompt_tokens, model.repo_id and model.revision

records: L11 (3): chunks run, prompts answered, keeps per chunk, seconds per chunk (wall time after a device sync), the GPU name and each chunk's answers' SHA-256; the lock's SHA-256; the model revision; engine X
requirement: REQ-9 (brief rev 1; RS B7); lead decisions L11, L14 and section 5 item 3 (b) (W1-06); the lead's Part C requirement (model-agnostic)
untuned: REC's policy through the engine's loaders, run with policy.model.disable_adapter() under torch.no_grad()
